summary: Look up each handler trap with GetMethod; missing/undefined traps forward to the corresponding target internal method while non-callable trap values throw.

target.notes: Use the JavaScript object-model runtime. Proxy semantics require trap lookup, handler calls, target internal methods, revocation checks, and invariant enforcement.

semantics.lookup: GetMethod on handler; getters may execute and throw
semantics.missing: undefined/null method result means forward to target internal method as specified
semantics.non_callable: present non-callable trap value causes TypeError
semantics.ordering: revocation validation and target/handler acquisition precede trap dispatch

caveats: Do not model Proxy as a plain C# decorator or Dictionary wrapper; observable internal-method interception and invariants must be preserved.
references: ECMAScript 2026 §10.5 Proxy Object Internal Methods and Internal Slots
